title: Admissions status and GES alignment
text: Admissions open. Enquiries for the 2026/27 academic year are being taken now. Aligned to GES standards. Mixed-age classrooms.

title: Preschool Ages 6 months to 5 years
text: Preschool · Ages 6 months to 5 years. Where curiosity begins. In the first plane of development, everything is absorbed through the senses. We prepare an environment where children can teach themselves through dignified, joyful inquiry.

title: CTA: Apply for preschool
text: Ready to join our preschool community? Give your child the foundation for a lifetime of learning through authentic Montessori education during the absorbent mind years, ages 6 months to 5. Apply for preschool

title: Absorbent Mind Years philosophy
text: The Absorbent Mind Years. Building the foundation of concentration. From six months to five years, a child's mind forms itself from the environment. They do not merely learn about the world; they absorb it.

title: Prepared environment
text: Our preschool classrooms are set entirely to the child's scale: low shelves, child-sized furniture, and materials that invite touch, sound, and movement. Through self-directed activity in a carefully prepared environment, children develop coordination, concentration, and independence.

title: Self-directed work choice
text: There are no bells, and no child is forced to wait to be told what to do next. Instead, they choose a material, take it to a mat, work until satisfied, and return it in condition.

title: Mixed-age age groups
text: Growing with your child. Classrooms are mixed-age communities where younger children learn from older peers.

title: Crèche 6 to 18 months
text: Crèche, 6 to 18 months. A nurturing environment focused on gross motor development, language acquisition, and trusting relationships.

title: Nursery 18 months to 3 years
text: Nursery, 18 months to 3 years. Emphasis on practical life skills, potty training, vocabulary building, and fine motor coordination.

title: Kindergarten 1 & 2
text: Kindergarten 1 & 2, 3 to 5 years. Introduction to the full Montessori curriculum including phonetic reading, decimal math, and cultural subjects.

title: Daily routine for preschoolers
text: A day in the life. A predictable routine provides the security children need to explore freely.

title: Morning Work Cycle 7:30 AM
text: 7:30 AM — Morning Work Cycle. Uninterrupted three-hour block. Children engage in practical life, sensorial, language, and math activities.

title: Outdoor Play and Snack
text: 10:30 AM — Outdoor Play & Snack. Time for gross motor movement and socialising over healthy snacks.

title: Group Lesson and Circle Time
text: 11:00 AM — Group Lesson & Circle Time. Stories, songs, and communal presentations.

title: Lunch and Rest
text: 12:00 PM — Lunch & Rest. Children assist in setting the table, followed by quiet rest time.

title: Afternoon Activities
text: 1:30 PM — Afternoon Activities. Continued exploration with materials, arts, and cultural subjects.

title: Dismissal
text: 3:30 PM — Dismissal Begins. Closing circle and parent pick-up.

title: Areas of discovery curriculum
text: Areas of discovery. The classroom is divided into distinct areas, each containing materials that progress sequentially from simple to complex, concrete to abstract.

title: Practical Life
text: Practical Life — Coordination, concentration, independence through daily activities. Care of Self: Dressing frames, hand washing, food preparation — children master the sequences of daily living. Care of Environment: Sweeping, polishing, watering plants, arranging flowers — real responsibility for shared spaces.

title: Grace and Courtesy, Control of Movement
text: Grace & Courtesy: Turn-taking, quiet movement, table manners, greeting — social confidence through practiced ritual. Control of Movement: Walking on the line, silence game, carrying materials — body awareness and self-regulation.

title: Sensorial refined senses
text: Sensorial — Refining the senses — dimension, colour, texture, sound, weight. Visual Discrimination: Pink tower, brown stair, red rods, colour boxes — grading by size, hue, and intensity. Tactile & Baric: Touch boards, fabric boxes, baric tablets — texture, weight, temperature perception.

title: Auditory and Stereognostic
text: Auditory & Olfactory: Sound cylinders, bells, smelling bottles — pitch, volume, scent identification. Stereognostic Sense: Mystery bag, geometric solids — recognising form through touch alone.

title: Language curriculum
text: Language — From spoken vocabulary to phonetic reading and writing. Oral Language: Vocabulary enrichment, storytelling, songs, nomenclature — the foundation of all literacy. Phonetic Awareness: Sound games, sandpaper letters — analysing spoken words into component sounds.

title: Writing before Reading
text: Writing Before Reading: Movable alphabet, metal insets — composing words before decoding them on paper. Reading & Grammar: Phonetic reading, puzzle words, grammar symbols — function of words made visible.

title: Mathematics decimal system
text: Mathematics — Concrete quantity to abstract symbol — the decimal system made tangible. Numbers 1–10: Number rods, sandpaper numerals, spindle box, cards & counters — quantity and symbol. Decimal System: Golden beads, number cards, bank game — place value experienced as physical exchange.

title: Mathematics Operations and Geometry
text: Operations: Collective exercises with golden beads — addition, subtraction, multiplication, division as group work. Geometry & Fraction: Geometric cabinet, constructive triangles, fraction insets — shape and part-whole relationships.

title: Prepared environment photo gallery
text: See our classrooms. Step inside the prepared environment.

title: Transition to Primary School
text: Looking ahead — Ready for Primary School. Moving from Kindergarten to Lower Primary is a gradual shift, not a cliff. Children carry their concentration stamina, their grace around materials, and their comfort with mixed-age collaboration into the primary classroom, seamlessly beginning the Great Lessons.
